c0f84865: ;If X starts with '?', branch to the question mark processor. If X starts with '^', execute D and branch to DIE17.
5be015a2: ;If X is '@', execute D and branch to DIE2.

9ece8fcd: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' (default value), DV doesn't contain 'P' (multiple), and a default value exists for the user/field, set X to the default value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' (disable) or 'S' (suppress), write the default value.

1321dd58: ;If DV is not null, branch to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', branch to DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', branch to P. If a DIEDIT exists for the field, execute it. Set % to the matching entry from DU, and Y to X. If % is not null, execute the DIC('S') screen. If the screen passes, write % unless DB(DQ) is defined (indicating an error), and branch to V.

16b28686: ;Loop through entries in DU. Set Y to each entry, and DG to the position of X within Y. Break out of the loop if Y is null or DG is non-zero. If DG is non-zero, execute the DIC('S') screen. If the screen passes, quit the loop.
27be9a37: ;If DB(DQ) is not defined (indicating no error), write the remainder of YS starting at DG. Set X to the portion of YS before the ':' character.

5facd074: ;If DV contains 'P' (multiple), set DIC to the entry from DU, and DIC(0) to 'ENM' or 'ELM' based on whether DB(DQ) is defined and whether DV contains a '''. If DV contains 'P2', set DLAYGO to the multiple number from DV. If DV doesn't contain '*', execute ^DIC to resolve the multiple. Set X to the IEN from Y, and DIC back to DIE. If X is negative, branch to X.
11347ce2: ;If DV doesn't contain 'N' (numeric), execute D. If the length of the fractional portion of X exceeds 24, kill X and branch to Z.

7a84e221: ;If the 2nd piece of DV is non-blank, X contains a decimal point, and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) doesn't contain a '$' (indicating a numeric field), then remove leading zeros from X. If the last digit of the fractional portion of X is 0, remove it. If the fractional portion is null and X contains a decimal point, convert X to a number.
88ca694f: ;Execute the X<DQ> routine, and kill YS.
1cf0b2a0: ;Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X is not null and not equal to up-arrow, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set the default value in ^DISV for the user/field to X. Branch to A.
